clearedSpotChecks.check: What a transient leak across transactions would hand the next transaction, read in src/.
clearedSpotChecks.note: unlock sets the flag, runs the callback, requires NonzeroDeltaCount to read zero and then locks (src/PoolManager.sol:104-114, src/libraries/Lock.sol:10-21). The only transient writers in src/ are Lock, NonzeroDeltaCount (src/libraries/NonzeroDeltaCount.sol:22,32), CurrencyDelta (src/libraries/CurrencyDelta.sol:39) and CurrencyReserves (src/libraries/CurrencyReserves.sol:23,29-30). _accountDelta raises the count when a delta leaves zero and lowers it when a delta reaches zero (src/PoolManager.sol:368-378), so a count of zero at the end of unlock means every delta is zero. A successful transaction can therefore leave only the synced currency and reserves set, which is the A1 case. The item is correct for src/. Its safety on a given chain still rests on the node clearing transient storage between transactions, which the medium lead on the uncleared commit_tx blocks keeps open.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Every saturating decrement of a depth word in the eight binaries, and the guard in front of the frame return commit comparing the result byte with 4 on celo and Arc (revm-interpreter 35) and with 5 on the other builds (revm-interpreter 37 and 43).
clearedSpotChecks.note: I fetched both crates. revm-interpreter 35.0.1 src/instruction_result.rs defines Stop = 1, Return, SelfDestruct, then Revert = 0x10, and return_ok! matches those three, so success is a result below 4. revm-interpreter 37.0.3 adds Suspend after SelfDestruct and return_ok! matches Stop, Return, SelfDestruct and Suspend, so success is a result below 5. The okbound.txt output in the work directory shows ('jae', 4) or the equivalent ('ja', 3) for celo1010 and arc086 and ('jae', 5) for the other six builds, which matches. I did not re-run the decrement interpreter. The 44 Base sites that were not interpreted were placed in non-journal code by the researcher's reading, and I did not confirm that placement myself.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 3 on celo-reth v1.0.10: the inlined commit_tx block and the discard path of CeloHandler::catch_error, run on populated journals, with alloy-evm finalize clearing again afterwards.
clearedSpotChecks.note: tx-celo-commit-38211.json and tx-celo-discard-38212.json each record 1000 cases, 0 bad, 0 errors, and 5988 and 5900 transient words cleared. The txfault-celo files exist for the five planted commit_tx faults. In revm-context 18.0.3, src/journal/inner.rs commit_tx clears transient_storage, sets depth to 0, clears journal and logs and increments transaction_id, and finalize clears logs, transient_storage and journal, sets depth to 0 and resets transaction_id to zero, as the item says. A missing transient clear on celo would hand a synced currency to the next transaction, so this is the costliest item if wrong, and both the source text and the run outputs back it. The same check for the seven other reth builds is still open as a medium lead, and that lead should stay open.
